Umeed rakho.
"Agar tum hell se guzar rahe ho—keep going."
Asli bano.
Jo tum roz karte ho, matter karta hai.
"Opportunity na aaye, darwaza khud banao."
Ambitious bano.
Wait mat karo; time kabhi perfect nahi hoga.
Din count mat karo—din ko count banado.
Tumhara mind ek garden hai. Tumhare thoughts beej hain.
Hum wahi bante hain jo din bhar sochte hain.
Fail hone se mat daro.
"Agar seekh sakta, grow kar sakta."
Mindset sab kuch hai.
Mindset altitude decide karta hai.
